meta.summary: OpenMHz: hides the app store and Donate buttons, the site counters, the activity chart and the footer
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chromium on https://openmhz.com/ with an iPhone UA at 390x844 and a desktop UA at 1440x900. The page ships two copies of the same Semantic UI layout (`div.fresnel-container.fresnel-greaterThanOrEqual-tablet` and `div.fresnel-container.fresnel-lessThan-tablet`) and shows one of them with a media query, so every count below is doubled; the visible count is half of it.

- **App store button**: `a.ui.button:has(i.app.store.ios)` 2 (1 visible) (LIVE).
- **Donate button**: `button:has(i.heart.icon)` 2 (1 visible) (LIVE).
- **Site counters**: `div.ui.statistic` 4 (2 visible) (LIVE).
- **Site Activity chart**: `div.ui.vertical.segment:has(svg)` 2 (1 visible) (LIVE).
- **Footer**: `#footer` 2 (1 visible) (LIVE).

The three shared cleanup rules (cookie dialog, Google ad slots, app-install banner) matched 0 elements on this page (LIVE), so they are inert here; they are kept because the site can serve a consent dialog from another region.

Not verified: the /systems list, the per-system radio pages, the Events podcast page, the About page and any signed-in state.
